Make a hostile planet breathable. The §6Atmosphere Terraformer§f gradually converts toxic or unbreathable atmosphere into an Earth-like mix, one percent at a time.

Vanilla recipe: titanium aluminide gears, dilithium gem, Liquid IO Circuit Board, Advanced Machine Structure, Control Circuit Board, and battery. Burns §65000 RF/t§f continuously and draws liquid oxygen, nitrogen, and CO2 from adjacent tanks.

Conversion rate is 1 atmosphere percent per 5 seconds per terraformer. A typical planet takes 1-2 real-time hours to fully terraform. Multiple terraformers chain together to speed it up.

§ePS:§f Pair with a Fusion Reactor for sustainable power over hours. Place at least 4 terraformers around the equator for uniform atmosphere distribution. The dilithium gem is the bottleneck, sourced from HBM.
